answer_1.quote: Experimental results on Chinese-to-English and French-to-English document-level translation tasks show that our approach not only significantly improves the translation performance in BLEU, but also greatly alleviates the problem of lexical translation inconsistency.
models: Proposed model with lexical-consistency attention and CVAE

answer_2.quote: We report both sentence-level metric (s-BLEU) and document-level metric (d-BLEU) to evaluate the quality of the translation. For all translation tasks, we report case-insensitive BLEU score calculated by multi-bleu.perl script. To evaluate the ability of enhancing the lexical translation consistency, we follow  and report the LTCR (Lexical Translation Consistency Ratio) score.
